steps.en: Install the whole set via skills.sh, or subscribe as a Claude Code plugin
steps.zh: 用 skills.sh 装整套，或订阅 Claude Code 插件

steps.en: Run the one-time setup in each repo you want to cover
steps.zh: 在每个要用的仓库跑一次 setup

steps.en: Interviews you on issue tracker, triage labels and docs location, then configures the repo
steps.zh: 问你 issue tracker、标签与文档位置，写入仓库配置

steps.en: Start every change with a grilling interview instead of a prompt dump
steps.zh: 每次改动先开一轮 grilling 访谈，而不是丢一段提示词

steps.en: Interviews until every design branch resolves, distilling shared vocabulary into CONTEXT.md and ADRs
steps.zh: 追问到设计树每个分支收敛，把术语沉淀进 CONTEXT.md 和 ADR

steps.en: Freeze the conversation into a spec, then break it into tickets
steps.zh: 把讨论定成 spec，再拆成工单

steps.en: Publishes the spec and blocking-linked tickets to the tracker you chose
steps.zh: 把 spec 和带阻塞关系的工单发到你选的 tracker

steps.en: Tell the agent to build the tickets
steps.zh: 让 agent 按工单开工

steps.en: Drives /tdd red-green-refactor per vertical slice and closes with a two-axis /code-review
steps.zh: 按 /tdd 红绿循环逐片实现，收尾跑两轴 /code-review

value.en: Every change goes through the same loop — align first, test-driven build, reviewed diff — without a heavyweight framework owning the process
value.zh: 每次改动都走同一条循环——先对齐、测试驱动实现、审查后提交——而不必让重型框架接管流程

sources: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills README.md (fetched 2026-09-27) — Installation section: `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`, `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, step 2 `Run /setup-matt-pocock-skills` (asks issue tracker: GitHub, Linear, or local files; triage labels; docs location)

README.md Reference section — user-invoked `/grill-with-docs` (grilling + domain model + CONTEXT.md + ADRs), `/to-spec`, `/to-tickets` (tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges), `/implement` (drives /tdd at seams, closes with /code-review)
README.md Reference section — model-invoked `/tdd` (red-green-refactor, vertical slices), `/code-review` (two-axis: Standards + Spec)
